{{Quote|Is that why you're all wrinkly, too?|Bress, to his grandmother Bastila|<ref name="Revan" />}}
'''Bress Shan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], the son of [[Vaner Shan|Vaner]] and [[Emess Shan]] and the grandson of the famous [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Bastila Shan]]. Born sometime before [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]], Bress was older than his sister [[Reesa Shan|Reesa]], and both children had inherited their [[Parent/Legends|grandparents]]' [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]]. In 3900 BBY, Vaner brought his children and wife to visit his mother on the anniversary of Bastila's marriage to Revan, who had disappeared over [[3954 BBY|fifty]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Reesa and Bress spent the evening playing with their grandmother in [[Revan and Bastila Shan's apartment|her apartment]] before their mother sent them to bed so that Vaner could be alone with Bastila.<ref name="Revan" /> Through Bress and Reesa, the [[Shan family]] would continue for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], with the Jedi Knight [[Tasiele Shan]], her daughter [[Satele Shan|Satele]], and Satele's son [[Theron Shan|Theron]] being among their descendants.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bress Shan was first mentioned along with his mother and siblings in the Epilogue of the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', which confirmed that the Shan family continued beyond Bastila and Revan to include the later [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Satele Shan.
